g.text: Market Desk | application classes through J08
Dashed arrows show service calls. Typed private fields show repository dependencies;
these fields are real constructor-injected collaborators, not persisted entity fields.
Repository interfaces extend Spring Data JpaRepository; their inherited CRUD is omitted.
Controllers also read CatalogService status and use HelloController formatting helpers.
Key operations are abbreviated. DTOs, framework filter/advice, Jackson, Clock and
transaction-manager plumbing are omitted. Packages group responsibility areas.
AppClockConfiguration supplies the shared Clock; NotificationPolicy uses Asia/Hong_Kong.
Catalogue replacement / observations / price rules share one transaction.
ShoppingService owns its mutation transaction; ReminderService.addToList does not wrap it.
